scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:daemon && npm run build:web
scripts.//dist:desktop: Builds the Windows installer. Needs build:shared and build:daemon to have run first — the staging step bundles their dist output.
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:daemon && npm --prefix apps/daemon-desktop run dist
scripts.//release:desktop: Builds the Windows installer and uploads it to GitHub Releases. Needs GH_TOKEN. Goes through build:shared and build:daemon first: the installer bundles apps/daemon/dist, so running electron-builder alone ships whatever the daemon was last compiled to — a released version that silently carries the previous version's daemon.
scripts.release:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:daemon && npm --prefix apps/daemon-desktop run release
scripts.//dist:portable: Builds the portable Linux/Android node bundle (arm64 by default; --arch=amd64 for a PC).
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:shared && npm run build:daemon && npm --prefix apps/daemon run dist:portable --
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:daemon && npm run test:web && npm run test:discord-bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:daemon && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:discord-bot
